name: Single-Leg Kettlebell Around-the-World
description: Stand on one leg, knee soft, the other leg lifted slightly off the floor. Pass the kettlebell around the body — hand to hand behind the back and in front — keeping the torso quiet and the standing-leg hip locked in. The standing-leg glute and hip stabilizers fight the rotational pull of the bell. Do the prescribed reps in one direction, then reverse direction; switch legs and repeat. Burns fast — the off-balance load multiplies the work.
